GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 684 (11 Oct 48) GC/TNG
(SCAPIN - 1945)
APO 500
29 November 1948
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Air-to-Air Gunnery Range.
1. The water area, with grid coordinates as follows, is designated as a danger area for an air-to-air gunnery range:
39° 16' North - 138° 58' East
39° 11' North - 139° 20' East
38° 35' North - 138° 40' East
38° 30' North - 139° 02' East
2. Hours of use of the range will be from 0700 hours to 1700 hours, local time, Mondays through Fridays. The coastal inhabitants from Oma to Kanazawa and the inhabitants of islands between these two places and adjacent to the Honshu coast will be notified prior to any period during which the range will be used. When the range is used for periods in excess of fifteen (15) days, warning reminders will be disseminated to the inhabitants concerned. This information will be forwarded through Military Government units to local Japanese civil authorities.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
